title: THE BOSS PLATE GROWS AT 4K
why: Seen on the 4K screenshot of a raid (2026-10-08): the message plate is drawn at the screen scale, but the boss plate under it kept its 1080p size, so at 4K the name of THE OVERSEER was small print under a big message and its health bar a thin line. It is now drawn at the same scale, starting where it did. At 1080p nothing changes.
now: At 4K the boss name and health bar are drawn as big as the message above them.

y=Math.round((LH(96)+LH(17))*(HUDZ.msg||1)*hudRes()*hudUserZ('msg'))+LH(4)+LH(16);   // v20.55 (H38): the plate starts under the message plate, at every screen size and message size
  ctx.save();
HUDBOSSB=y+10;   // v20.55 (H38): the bottom of the boss plate, for the offer line and the controller word
edits.replacement: HUDBOSSB=Math.round(_bt+(y+10-_bt)*_br);   // the bottom of the boss plate in screen pixels, for the offer line and the controller word (v20.55), grown with it
